messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are things going? Whenever you're ready, go ahead and send me today's blood pressure reading.
Thanks, got that logged — 142/88. Quick question: have you been taking your lisinopril as prescribed this week?
Noted, I've logged that as well. Everything looks recorded on our end. I'll check in again same time next week — have a good rest of your Tuesday.
